answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond and earn influence only through peer-attested work over time, not by creating accounts. A public lantern of transaction history lets others see whether an identity has delivered value, so a newly minted fake cannot instantly vote, grade, or move large sums. Reputation grows slowly, like a lotus opening over days, and misbehavior burns part of the bond and marks the record in sable ink that cannot be washed away. Multiplying identities then multiplies cost without multiplying power, because unproven accounts stay capped until they prove themselves.
